S1.old: This 1964 20 centavos coin from Mexico was struck in brass (95% copper and 5% zinc). The reverse shows the Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan with the volcanoes Popocatépetl and Iztaccíhuatl behind it under a radiant Phrygian cap (cap of liberty). At the top the value 20 is divided by the cap, with the Mo mint mark beneath it; the word CENTAVOS and the 1964 date also appear on this side. The obverse displays the Mexican national arms.
